notes.title: V1.10 Update on 21st October
notes.notes:
Multi save data, resetting and random setting are now available!
We add functions of those with player's request!
You can now play with setting prediction using random setting and save data!

Note: Lucky Ptns. will be shared all save data.

notes.title: V1.01b Minor Update on 18th September
notes.notes:
Enjoy playing A-Rabbit on Mac OS!
A-Rabbit is now available not only on Windows but also Mac OS.
It is also adapted x-platform link for steam cloud. Please have fun by your favorite platform!

It is included minor bug fix.

notes.title: V1.01 Minor Update on 5th September
notes.notes:
How to is extended regarding effect rules and RT.
You can check extra explanation from how to on the menu.

Add "Show slip count" settings.
You can see slip count lively. Check settings on the menu to activate.
